verdict.rationale: Docs confirm one Financial Connections session/client_secret lets a user link an account and expose auth, balances, ownership/identity, and transactions data together (docs-1, docs-8/9/10, docs-2/3/4), and a community integrator confirms using the same link for verification, ACH fraud signal, and adjacent Stripe products (comm-6). missing for 10: no explicit first-party statement that all four data products are requested/returned in a single session without re-prompting the user, and one community report notes transactions/other data products were 'coming soon' at beta (comm-8), leaving some ambiguity about full simultaneous availability.
